rules.readerAdvice: Move numericFormat.culture to locale and update the renderer in the same change. A custom renderer may read numericFormat.culture, but 18.0 formats with locale, so the renderer would fall back to its default culture if only the key moved.

rules.name: correctFormat
rules.advice: Use valueParser or valueSetter to correct entered values. 18.0 removed correctFormat. The date, time, intl-date, and intl-time cell types work with ISO 8601 values and do not reformat input.

rules.name: datePickerConfig
rules.advice: Check the native date input, which replaces Pikaday. The date and intl-date cell types use it, and 18.0 removed datePickerConfig.

rules.message: Rename columnHeaders to colHeaders: the export option is deprecated since 17.1 and 19.0 removes it. colHeaders keeps the meaning of the value.
